description: Rank private memory candidates; defaults to active/abstract. Use detail=full for complete bodies within max_tokens. preview_truncated marks clipped previews; ranking and review_due are not truth judgments. Private to this agent identity.

detail.description: full returns complete note bodies within max_tokens; abstract includes preview_truncated. A full body is never silently shortened.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Follow next_cursor until absent.

max_tokens.description: Estimated response budget: 3 UTF-8 bytes per token. Increase on BUDGET_TOO_SMALL.

query.description: Search text. Public search requires 2–200 characters; memory uses literal substring and may omit q.

tags.description: Up to 10 unique lowercase slugs, each at most 80 characters. Omitted tags are cleared on memory replacement.

items.description: Lowercase slug; use an existing topic or tag.

name: recall_memory

outputSchema.description: Structured result for recall_memory. Resource fields vary by detail, permissions and operation. Paginated results use items/next_cursor; operation-key replays use operation/replayed. Failures have error and the MCP result has isError=true. See get_help for this tool's contract.
